method: Whole-file reading of four release workflows/build scripts; exact bytes verified against pinned Git blob inventory. No publishing or foreign scripts executed.
findings: Release matrix builds net9.0-windows/net481 on x64/x86/arm64 but contains no test execution. Version affects output names; MSBuild invocation does not override project Version, allowing filename/binary-version mismatch for other tags.
SignPath signing is configured for bundles and installer; source configuration does not establish actual release signature validity. Draft release creation follows signing jobs.
Winget publication uses mutable vedantmgoyal9/winget-releaser@main. Other action tags and windows-latest also do not establish reproducible immutable build inputs.
Chocolatey builder computes SHA256 from downloaded release installer without independently expected digest/signature verification in this script.
Template substitutions do not escape XML or PowerShell special characters. Fixed package directory is recursively removed before construction.
PowerShell builder does not set ErrorActionPreference=Stop or explicitly check native choco pack/push exit codes; pack failure can continue toward push, potentially selecting an existing package.
limits: Static source review only; no release, installation, Windows build or original application test executed.
148 of 500 repositories fully reviewed; this repository remains partial at 48/104. Native pHash memory-error investigation deferred.
